Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009.name: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009
Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009.summary: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009 is a hunting video game published by Activision for the PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, Wii, and Xbox 360 video game consoles. It was released in the United States on September 23, 2008.

Def Jam - Rapstar.name: Def Jam Rapstar
Def Jam - Rapstar.summary: Def Jam Rapstar is a rapping game developed by 4mm Games. The game was released on October 5, 2010 in the United States of America (U.S.), and released on November 26, 2010 in Europe. An official launch event was held at New York's Hudson hotel on October 6, 2010 to celebrate the game's U.S. release. As of October 5, 2011, the community site has been shut down with no official word on when or if it will be reopened, causing major features of the game to be inaccessible.

Metroid Prime.name: Metroid Prime
Metroid Prime.summary: Wii de Asobu: Metroid Prime (also known as New Play Control! Metroid Prime) is a port of Metroid Prime for the Wii with motion controls compatibility. This port later released as a part of Metroid Prime: Trilogy in the West.

Pacific Liberator.name: Pacific Liberator
Pacific Liberator.summary: This all-action helicopter game puts you in the cockpit for high speed aerial combat over volatile action in the Pacific. In Pacific Liberator, you'll be thrown into high-flying warfare besting the forces of El Presidente, the ultimate enemy. El Presidente built his palace on a man-made island in the Pacific, and is terrorizing the poor citizens of the surrounding islands. Your mission is to strategically free the region island by island until you take upon El Presidente himself!

Sid Meier's Pirates!.name: Sid Meier's Pirates!
Sid Meier's Pirates!.summary:
Based on Sid Meier's original masterpiece, Pirates!, Sid Meier's Pirates! has you facing countless dogged enemies, wooing fair maidens and raising the Jolly Roger on the high seas in pursuit of riches. Discover what it takes to become one of the most famous pirates in history!

Firaxis' long-awaited Sid Meier's Pirates! carries on with the great game play tradition and design simplicity of the award-winning original while adding more challenging and exciting battle options, eye-popping 3D graphics, fantastic new audio, and loads of new game play features!
